P ≠ NP: FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · KERNEL v1.13.0 · EVERY NAME CHECKED
PROVEN UNCONDITIONALLY · THEOREM GRADE · NOTHING BEFORE THE COLON

text.font-family: PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: proven_unconditionally · unconditional_real_part_separation
SAT ∈ NP, BUILT IN THE KERNEL
A 5,120-state one-tape verifier over nineteen
tape symbols accepts every satisfiable formula,
given its certificate, within 5000·n⁴ + 5000
steps, and accepts no unsatisfiable one. The
membership half of Cook and Levin is a theorem.

svg.text: DEGREE 0 · CONSTANT TIME FAILS
No Turing machine decides SAT within a constant
budget. Locality is proved once for every
machine, and a computed witness defeats every
decider at every constant.

svg.text: DEGREE 1 · LINEAR TIME FAILS
No one-tape Turing machine decides SAT within
c·n + c steps, at any c: Hennie's crossing
sequences, run on SAT's own fooling family.

svg.text: THE REAL-PART SEPARATION
SAT ∈ NP, SAT outside constant and linear
one-tape time, and the bit equal to the Diagonal
Target from degree 2, in one theorem with
nothing before the colon.

tspan.font-family: PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE NORMAL FORM
Over every Turing machine, SAT ∉ P is exactly
one implication: least escape carried from the
record of the SAT machine to the machine.

svg.text: THE RECORD CLOSES
The record answers every run wrongly, so it has
least escape on no axiom. At TMSAT it is a fixed
point carrying separation, self-recursion and a
fertile machine.

svg.text: THE BIT ON NO AXIOM
The transfer in its constructive form, landing on
“no decider escapes”, is exactly SAT ∉ P on an
empty cone: no propext, no choice, no quotient.

tspan.font-family: PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: EVERY ROUTE PASSES THE BIT
Any proof of SAT ∉ P, from any premise, is a
proof of the bit. Every exit is the posit and the
posit every exit. One certificate, one proof.

svg.text: TEN FACES, ONE PROPOSITION
SAT ∉ P, the separation at SAT, Sep, closure,
self-recursion, record coincidence, the fertile
machine, the selected machine, the physical
witness and the degree tail: one bit.

svg.text: THE RESIDUE, EXACT
The bit is the Diagonal Target at every degree
k ≥ 2, and equally the tail from any degree
m ≥ 1. The ladder may be cut anywhere.

svg.text: THE BIT DELIVERS P ≠ NP
With SAT ∈ NP built, the bit and every one of its
faces give P ≠ NP with nothing cited.

svg.text: THE MODEL, BUILT
Finite-control Turing machines on one two-way
tape, running time as the first halting step, a
binary encoding with its decoder proved inverse,
SAT as a language, P and NP as definitions.
